certification_status_rationale: Full data->features->labels->training->OOS validation->calibration->backtest->risk->decision->registry->shadow->paper feedback->drift lifecycle is implemented, wired end-to-end, and executed. All P0 blockers are closed. However, the trained champion does NOT survive realistic transaction costs (net Sharpe negative after 10bps), so the system is NOT eligible for shadow or production capital allocation. Honest outcome: NO VERIFIED COST-SURVIVING EDGE on the current feature/label/universe configuration.

data_source.note: The certification harness (scripts/run_certification.py) was executed against the LIVE data-service2.0 at http://localhost:8200 using real NSE historical data for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/RELIANCE (1334 dataset rows). A prior SYNTHETIC_FALLBACK run (reports/certification_run.json) is retained for comparison; the numbers below reflect the LIVE real-data run.

live_real_data_result.verdict: On REAL NSE daily data with the current 24-feature / triple-barrier / 3-symbol configuration, the trained models show ZERO out-of-sample IC and high PBO (0.6) — NO VERIFIED EDGE. The system correctly refused to certify. Note: NSE index instruments report zero traded volume, degrading volume-based features; expanding the universe to liquid single stocks, using intraday bars, and richer features are the indicated research directions. This negative result is reported honestly (mandate §101, §111).

model_version.selection_rule: best walk-forward mean IC with parsimony tiebreak (baseline preferred within margin)
model_version.note: Advanced tree models did NOT beat the logistic baseline on OOS IC; the simpler model was selected (complexity must be earned).

unit_tests.note: 159 new behavioural tests with real assertions across ingestion, labels, features, dataset, estimators, walk-forward, CPCV, orchestrator, calibration, backtest, position sizing, expected value, lifecycle, drift, feedback, self-learning, decision trace, signal contract, and end-to-end certification. 26 pre-existing API auth/validation tests (401/422) fail in this environment for reasons unrelated to this work (verified by stash).

leakage_tests.lookahead_guard_at_inference: WIRED (blocks in inference mode, counts in backtest mode)
leakage_tests.pit_truncation_invariant: PROVEN (feature values unchanged when future bars appended)

statistical_tests.cpcv: REAL — combinatorial paths C(6,2)=15, purge+embargo, distribution of path ICs, PBO estimate
statistical_tests.walk_forward: REAL — 5 OOS windows, honesty verified (noise -> IC~0, signal -> IC>0)

baseline_comparison.result: logistic baseline matched/beat advanced models on OOS IC

calibration_results.gate: calibration_gate() max_ece=0.10, max_brier=0.25; enforced in TrainingOrchestrator acceptance

backtest_results.verdict: Signal does not survive realistic costs at any tested level; net Sharpe negative. Turnover too high for the thin edge.

latency_results.note: Trained logistic/tree models load in <1s; per-decision latency dominated by feature computation. Full benchmark pending live deployment.

acceptance_criteria.D_real_data_training: PARTIAL (pipeline complete; certification run used synthetic fallback because data-service2.0 was unreachable)
acceptance_criteria.E_real_historical_backtesting: PASS (cost-aware engine; ran on the frozen dataset)
acceptance_criteria.R_failure_recovery: PARTIAL (graceful degradation implemented; full chaos suite pending)

p0_blockers.evidence: TrainingOrchestrator produces immutable pickled artifacts with sha256 via ModelRegistry; certification run trained logistic/lightgbm/xgboost.

p0_blockers.title: No label factory
p0_blockers.evidence: src/data/labels.py LabelFactory (fixed_horizon, triple_barrier, vol_adjusted, meta) with MAE/MFE/costs.

p0_blockers.evidence: MetaDecisionEngine.decide() now threads real data_quality; DATA_QUALITY_FAILURE gate active.

p0_blockers.evidence: MetaOutput now carries prediction_timestamp, feature_as_of, data_as_of, news_as_of, expires_at + provenance fields.

p0_blockers.title: LookAheadGuard not called at inference
p0_blockers.evidence: FeaturePipeline invokes LookAheadGuard; inference mode blocks, backtest mode counts.

promotion_decision.reason: All infrastructure P0 blockers closed and the full lifecycle is operational and tested. The trained model shows weak positive OOS IC (0.042) with low PBO (0.067) but NEGATIVE net Sharpe after 10bps costs — no verified cost-surviving edge. Per the mandate, a negative research result is reported honestly rather than gamed. Production/shadow require a champion that survives realistic costs.
promotion_decision.next_milestone: Run the certification harness against live data-service2.0 data; investigate label horizon/universe/feature set to find a cost-surviving edge or confirm none exists on this configuration; reduce turnover.
